meta.name: crisis-response
meta.description: Assess a PR crisis and deliver a structured response plan — severity classification (Level 1-3), a ready-to-publish holding statement, tailored messaging per stakeholder group, an hour-by-hour communication timeline, and a trust-rebuilding roadmap. Drafts and plans only; it publishes nothing. Triggers on "/digital-marketing-pro:crisis-response", "we're getting slammed on social media", "draft a holding statement fast", "a negative story just broke about us", "how do we respond to this backlash". Reads the brand profile, voice settings, guidelines, and market compliance rules before drafting any statement.
